77029.subject: 🔷 The Daily: Clarity Act's odds sink to 23% as deadline nears
77029.body:
Circle names BlackRock, DTCC among Arc validators as Q2 revenue hits $701 million | Eliza Labs founder declares native token 'dead,' winds down foundation after Burwick Law settlement | 'Panic visible onchain': Bitcoin activity hits 2026 high amid Coldcard attack as K33 flags potential bottoming pattern | BlackRock's spot Ethereum ETF to undergo 1-for-3 reverse share split in October |

The Daily ( https://www.theblock.co/?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters )

Written by James Hunt | Edited by Kyle Baird

Presented by:

BitGo ( https://www.bitgo.com/?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters )

Happy Wednesday! A quick heads-up: we'll be on the ground at *SALT's Blockchain Symposium* ( https://www.salt.org/events/wyoming-blockchain-symposium-2026?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ) in *Jackson Hole* later this month, with exclusive interviews and coverage of the biggest stories shaping crypto and global finance.

In today's newsletter, *Bitwise* says crypto "will be fine" even if the *Clarity Act* fails to pass, *Circle* names *BlackRock* among *Arc* validators amid its Q2 results, *Eliza Labs'* founder declares its native token "dead," and more.

Meanwhile, *Cloudflare* kicked off a stablecoin wallet rollout ( https://www.theblock.co/post/410629/cloudflare-kicks-off-stablecoin-wallet-rollout-ai-agents-pay-apis-online-content?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ) for AI agents to pay for APIs and online content.

*👀 P.S.* Don't forget to check out our latest reader poll on the *Clarity Act* later in the newsletter.

*THE BIG ONE*

*🏛️ Crypto 'will be fine' even if Clarity fails to pass this week, Bitwise CIO Matt Hougan says*

( https://www.theblock.co/post/410676/crypto-will-be-fine-if-clarity-fails-matt-hougan?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters )

*Bitwise* CIO *Matt Hougan* said crypto "will be fine" even if the *Clarity Act* fails to pass this week, saying the industry will "find a way forward" regardless.

* The *Senate* has just a few days to advance the bill before its Aug. 10 to Sept. 11 recess, as *President Trump's* alleged crypto conflicts of interest remain a sticking point.
* Hougan said the *Securities and Exchange Commission* under Chair *Paul Atkins* is willing to step in with rules that address many of the same issues if needed, and is likely to be more crypto-friendly than a bipartisan bill.
* However, he cautioned that a future administration could install a less friendly SEC chair to reverse those rules, but said crypto would have at least two and a half years to cement its progress first.
* Hougan said the bill would enter a "walking dead" state if it fails to pass, unable to be killed but lurching along and possibly folded into year-end omnibus legislation.
